text:
maya: quick ping — I opened a PR for halcyon-3b tokenizer tweaks + a matching quant profile. can someone take a look? aiming to merge before tomorrow's deploy window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482 :wave:

sam: taking a look now. which part is most urgent — tokenizer tokenization fixes or the quant settings? :eyes:

maya: main urgency is the tokenizer change (handles a stray unicode sequence we've seen in logs) + small quant profile tweak to avoid OOM on 24GB instances. both in same PR. diff has short snippet:```python
# tokenizer tweak
def normalize_input(s):
    return s.replace('﻿', '')
```

jordan: I can review the quant profile. quick note: layerwise.max_group_size=128 looks risky, can we try 64 first? also please add a smoke test in `ci/smoke/halcyon.yaml` to catch runtime mismatch.

maya: good call — i swapped to 128 because of perf, but i'll change to 64 and add a quick smoke job. thanks. @sam pinging you for tokenizer LGTM when you finish.

sam: tokenizer looks fine but two nits: add a small unit test for the BOM case, and document the behavior in the tokenizer README. otherwise LGTM.

ravi: CI is flaky on this repo today, i'll queue a rerun when you push the fixes. tagging `ci-bot` to start the smoke job after push.

ci-bot: CI queued: models/pr/482 — running smoke + unit tests. (started)

ci-bot: CI passed: models/pr/482 — all checks green :white_check_mark:

maya: pushed changes (unit test + README + quant to 64). @jordan can you re-check the profile? link updated in PR description.

jordan: rechecked, looks good. minor comment about a doc line but not blocking. approved. :rocket:

sam: lgtm for tokenizer, added :shipit: reaction on the PR.

maya: awesome — merging now so it lands before the deploy window. thanks y'all! :tada:

maya: merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482/files — will monitor telemetry for tokenization errors in the next 2h. if anything spikes i'll open a rollback.

ravi: noted, will keep an eye on infra logs.

maya: thanks everyone!
